items.title: Apple (AAPL) Readies Foldable iPhone As Samsung Launches New Rival Phones
items.summary: Samsung has launched new foldable phones as Apple, NasdaqGS:AAPL, is reported to be preparing its first foldable iPhone for a planned September debut. This move sets up direct competition between Apple and Samsung in the foldable smartphone segment. Industry projections suggest Apple could take up to a quarter of the foldable market once its device is released.
